traditional.duration_provenance: Multi-Cloud High (10 epics, predominant L/XL: 2 XL + 3 L out of 10, 7 legacy systems integrated, baseline 26-40 weeks). Adjusted: +15% regulated industry (LGPD Art. 48 + TCU audit trail + perfil de acesso governance TI+Jurídico+DPO), +10% new client (first-time Dataprev, unknown org quality, Protheus governance blocker G1002 unresolved), +10% confidence widening (68 gaps, G1002 blocker, volumetrias pending, Experience Design gap, Governance gap — many Unknowns/Assumed). Total adders +35% (under +50% cap). From timeline.derived (.project-metadata.json).
traditional.capacity_summary: Scope-scaling team; offshore-weighted build pod (4-7 offshore developers + QA) + onshore core (4 continuous: R01 Senior Tech Architect, R03 MuleSoft Architect, R06 Solution Architect, R10 BA/Release) + onshore fractional specialists (R02 Agentforce F1-F3, R04 MuleSoft dev F1-F3, R05 Data Cloud F3, R07 CM F0-F2 peak, R08 UX F0-F2, R09 Analytics F3, R11 QA surge F1/F2/F3 hardening). Peak capacity F2: ~12-15 pessoas.

quantum-leap.duration_provenance: Traditional baseline 29-54 weeks compressed by efficiency Low readiness realized band ~10-14% (from efficiency.json project_level). Readiness score 2/8 (AI tooling posture 0/2, delivery velocity 1/2, data hygiene 1/2, legal/compliance 0/2) drives Low scenario. Compression = task-level ~30-40% × realization factor 0.40-0.45 = ~12-18% project-level, Low readiness reduces to ~10-14%.
quantum-leap.capacity_summary: Team derived to need (work→roles + QL adjustments); senior core + agent fleet + fractional specialists. Onshore senior core 6 continuous F0-F3 (R01, R02 Agentforce as agent director, R03, R04 MuleSoft dev as agent director, R06, R10) + fractional specialists 5 (R05 Data Cloud F3, R07 CM F0-F2 peak, R08 UX F0-F2, R09 Analytics F3, R11 QA surge F1/F2/F3 — agent-amplified never replaced, surges hardening) + 0 offshore (agents absorb build volume — 7 legacy API connectors, 9 Agentforce agents, Data Cloud config, test execution). Peak capacity F2: ~10-11 pessoas.
quantum-leap.provisional_note: Compression band provisional until QL actuals accumulate (decisions/0011). Low readiness ~10-14% based on current client signals; moving to High readiness ~18-22% requires 5 unlocks: AI tooling approval for PS delivery team, G1002 Protheus governance resolution, LGPD/TCU-compliant AI-assisted delivery policy, volumetrias audit, data model reconciliation plan across 7 legacy systems.

delta.summary: QL vs Traditional: ~34-36% lower price via (1) compressed duration (25-49w vs 29-54w, ~14-9% faster via AI efficiency Low readiness), (2) team derived to need (10-11 pessoas senior-core vs 12-15 offshore-weighted, ~17-27% fewer — offshore build pod eliminated, agents absorb volume under senior core), (3) rate-class mix (100% onshore senior vs offshore-weighted blend).
